newsitem.title: USA: Hughes to acquire PanAmSat - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Hughes to acquire PanAmSat - NYT.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp, a unit of General Motors Corp, plans to announce on Friday that it will buy PanAmSat Corp in a deal worth $3 billion, the New York Times reported Friday.
Citing unnamed sources, the newspaper said Hughes would merge PanAmSat with its domestic satellite network to create a new publicly traded company.

The deal is expected to close within six to 12 months, it said, adding that it was worth $30 a share or $3 billion for PanAmSat's shareholders -- a 9.25-percent premium over the company's market value of $2.77 billion.
The newspaper said Hughes would own 71.5 percent of the company and PanAmSat's shareholders would own the other 28.5 percent.
PanAmSat, to be based in Greenwich, would become the second largest satellite company in the world, it said.
Neither company was immediately available to comment on the article.
